behaviour: Adds a summary, @param entity and @returns to each of the 8 kind type guards, above their existing @public tag.
rules: 1. Each site inserts, right after the guard's existing '/**' line, these lines in order: ' * <summary>', ' *', ' * @param entity - The entity to check', ' * @returns <returns text>', ' *'; the existing ' * @public' line then follows unchanged and stays last.

2. Summary for guard X with kind literal K and interface I: 'Checks whether an entity is of the `K` kind, comparing `entity.kind` to `K` case-insensitively.' followed by 'Only `kind` is checked; `apiVersion` and `spec` are not validated.'
3. Returns text: '`true` if the entity kind matches, which narrows the type to {@link I}, otherwise `false`.'

4. Pairs (guard, K, I): isApiEntity, API, ApiEntityV1alpha1; isComponentEntity, Component, ComponentEntityV1alpha1; isDomainEntity, Domain, DomainEntityV1alpha1; isGroupEntity, Group, GroupEntityV1alpha1; isLocationEntity, Location, LocationEntityV1alpha1; isResourceEntity, Resource, ResourceEntityV1alpha1; isSystemEntity, System, SystemEntityV1alpha1; isUserEntity, User, UserEntityV1alpha1.
5. Blocks are at top level (no indentation before ' *').

behaviour: Adds a TSDoc block with summary, @param value and @returns to each of the 8 static validator methods.
rules: 1. Each block is indented two spaces and has: summary, ' *', ' * @param value - The value to check', ' * @returns <text>'; every @returns says the method returns `false` for any non-string value.

2. isValidApiVersion: the value is either `<version>` or `<group>/<version>`; `<group>` must pass {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain} (at most 253 characters of dot-separated lowercase DNS labels); `<version>` is 1 to 63 ASCII letters or digits; a value with more than one `/` is invalid.
3. isValidKind: 1 to 63 characters, starting with an ASCII letter followed only by ASCII letters or digits (for example `Component`).
4. isValidObjectName: 1 to 63 characters of ASCII letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
5. isValidNamespace: delegates to {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsLabel}: 1 to 63 characters of lowercase letters and digits, where hyphens may appear only between them (not first or last).

6. isValidLabelKey and isValidAnnotationKey (same rule, separate blocks): the value is `<name>` or `<prefix>/<name>`; `<prefix>` must pass {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain} and `<name>` must pass {@link KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName}; a value with more than one `/` is invalid.
7. isValidLabelValue: the empty string, or a value that passes {@link KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName}.
8. isValidAnnotationValue: any string, including the empty string; there is no length or character limit.

rules: 1. Summary: fills in `metadata.namespace` with the namespace given to the constructor (`default` unless another is passed) when the entity has none.
2. '@param entity - The entity to process'.

3. '@returns' text: the same entity object, unchanged, if `metadata.namespace` is set to a non-empty value; otherwise a new entity object, deep-merged from the input over the default namespace, so the input entity is not modified.
4. Do not claim an empty-string or `null` namespace is replaced (the merge keeps the entity's own value); do not add @throws (the method throws no error of its own).

rules: 1. Summary: checks the format of the entity envelope fields with the validators given to the constructor (by default those of {@link makeValidator}).

2. @remarks lists, in order: `apiVersion`, `kind` and `metadata.name` must be present; `metadata.namespace` is checked only when it is not `undefined`; every label key and value, annotation key and value, and tag is checked; each entry in `metadata.links` needs a valid `url`, and its `title` and `icon` must be non-empty strings when not `undefined`; `spec` is not checked.
3. '@param entity - The entity to check'.
4. '@returns' text: the same entity object, unchanged.

5. '@throws' text: an `Error` naming the field when a required field is `undefined` or `null`, when a validator throws, or when a value fails its validator; for a known validator the message describes the expected format and links to the catalog file format documentation.

rules: 1. Summary: validates the entity against the entity envelope JSON schema, which requires `apiVersion`, `kind` and `metadata`, allows only the top-level fields `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata`, `spec`, `relations` and `status`, and checks `metadata` against the shared metadata schema.
